stories.title: What to Know About Nvidia’s Investigation of CEO Jensen Huang
stories.summary: Nvidia's board is currently evaluating the position of its chief executive, Jensen Huang. This review follows his admission of an affair with a woman identified by U.S. intelligence as a Chinese spy.

stories.title: OpenAI Builds AI Kill Switch That Can Stop Rogue Models In 35 Seconds: How It Works
stories.summary: OpenAI has developed a new safety system called 'Control Room' that can quickly stop AI models. This system is designed to intervene if AI models show unexpected behavior or become a security risk.

stories.title: Nvidia Spy Scandal: Chinese AI Firms Rush To Secure Chips Before US Crackdown
stories.summary: Chinese AI companies are urgently trying to acquire Nvidia chips from international sources. This rush is driven by worries about potential U.S. restrictions after a controversy involving Nvidia's CEO.

stories.title: Using Google Chrome? Hackers Can Take Control Of Your Device, Govt Issues Alert
stories.summary: Users of Google Chrome are at risk of hackers taking control of their devices. The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) has issued an urgent warning about these security threats.

stories.title: OpenAI brings local AI processing to India for eligible API users
stories.summary: OpenAI is now offering local AI processing capabilities in India for eligible API users.

stories.title: Nvidia Shares Plummet as Board Considers Jensen Huang’s Future as CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia's stock dropped significantly after news emerged that the company's board was evaluating the future of its CEO, Jensen Huang. This development had a ripple effect across global markets.

stories.title: Retail Inflation Surges To 6.09% In October, Breaches RBI's Upper Tolerance Limit
stories.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09 percent in October, exceeding the central bank's upper tolerance limit. This increase was driven by a surge in food inflation, which reached 8.94 percent.

stories.title: RBI Mulls Tighter Rules For Private Equity Ownership In Multiple NBFCs: Report
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is reportedly considering stricter regulations for private equity firms that own controlling stakes in multiple non-banking financial companies. This move could alter ownership structures and increase regulatory scrutiny.

stories.title: Sensex, Nifty End Higher As Investors Track Crude Oil Prices; Trump Says 'Iran War Will End When We Want'
stories.summary: Indian stock markets closed higher as investors monitored crude oil prices and reacted to US President Donald Trump's comments about the conflict in Iran. The market's performance reflected these external factors.

stories.title: Adani Group Plans $1.45 Billion Equity Push To Finance €2.56 Billion Evos Acquisition
stories.summary: The Adani Group intends to raise up to $1.45 billion through equity to help fund its €2.56 billion acquisition of Evos. The remaining amount for the acquisition is expected to be financed by global lenders.

stories.title: Colom Will Be Mississippi’s First Black Senator Since Reconstruction
stories.summary: Colom is set to become Mississippi's first Black senator since the Reconstruction era.

stories.title: White House Threatens Congress, Saying Aggressive Investigations Could Be Crime
stories.summary: The White House has warned Congress that aggressive investigations could be considered a crime. It is unclear what legal grounds support this threat, as the Constitution provides lawmakers with immunity for legislative actions.

stories.title: Norwegian Journalist, Who Questioned PM Modi, Claims Visa Revoked Hours Before India Trip
stories.summary: A Norwegian journalist claims their visa was revoked just hours before a planned trip to India, after having previously questioned Prime Minister Modi.

stories.title: Republicans Begin Aggressive Lame-Duck Push to Install Trump Judges
stories.summary: Republicans are making a strong effort to confirm approximately two dozen federal judges during the lame-duck session before they lose power. Democrats have stated they will try to prevent these confirmations.

stories.title: Sonia's Memoir Reopens Super PM Row: Did She Run UPA From Behind Manmohan Singh? | Briefing Room
stories.summary: Sonia's memoir has brought back discussions about whether she was the primary power behind Manmohan Singh's government.

stories.title: DHS proposes new H-1B extension rule: Workers in US could face stricter checks even with same employer
stories.summary: The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has proposed a new rule for H-1B visa extensions. This change could lead to more rigorous checks for workers in the United States, even if they continue to be employed by the same company.

stories.title: IBM to End H-1B Visa and Green Card Sponsorship for Most IBM Consulting Roles by the End of 2026
stories.summary: IBM plans to stop sponsoring H-1B visas and green cards for most positions within its consulting division. This policy change is expected to be fully implemented by the end of 2026.

stories.title: $100,000 OPT fees could shut international students out of post-study work, US universities warn | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: US universities are expressing concern that potential fees of $100,000 for Optional Practical Training (OPT) could prevent international students from pursuing post-study work opportunities.

stories.title: H-1B, green card applicants may face potential wage hikes as rule advances for federal review | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: A new rule advancing for federal review could lead to increased wage requirements for H-1B and green card applicants. This change may impact the cost of employing these workers.

stories.title: Brown will no longer issue CPT work authorizations for international undergraduates
stories.summary: Brown University has announced that it will no longer provide Curricular Practical Training (CPT) work authorizations for its international undergraduate students.
